hotelDesc.overview:
Experience Timeless Elegance at Fairmont Peace Hotel on the Bund, Shanghai

Nestled just a kilometer from the vibrant heart of Shanghai’s city center, the Fairmont Peace Hotel on the Bund offers a perfect blend of historic charm and modern luxury. Originally built in 1929 and beautifully renovated in 2010, this iconic hotel stands as a testament to Shanghai’s rich history and dynamic spirit. Guests can enjoy breathtaking views of the Huangpu River and the city skyline, all while indulging in world-class amenities and impeccable service. With a total of 268 elegantly appointed rooms, the Fairmont Peace Hotel provides a comfortable retreat for travelers seeking both comfort and convenience. Check-in begins at 3:00 PM, and guests are kindly asked to check out by 12:00 PM. Conveniently located just an hour from Pudong International Airport, the hotel offers easy access for international travelers. Families are welcomed with an accommodating child policy, allowing children aged 2 to 11 to stay free of charge, making it an ideal destination for both leisure and family adventures.

Unparalleled Entertainment Facilities at Fairmont Peace Hotel

Indulge in a world of luxury and entertainment at Fairmont Peace Hotel in Shanghai, China. With a wide range of entertainment facilities, this iconic hotel offers an unforgettable experience for every guest. Step into a haven of retail therapy with the hotel's exquisite shops, where you can find a variety of high-end fashion, jewelry, and souvenirs. After a day of exploring the vibrant city, unwind at the hotel's bar, where expert mixologists craft signature cocktails in a sophisticated setting. For ultimate relaxation, pamper yourself with a rejuvenating massage at the hotel's spa. Immerse yourself in pure bliss as skilled therapists work their magic, leaving you feeling refreshed and rejuvenated. Indulge in the hotel's hot tub, sauna, and steam room, where you can unwind and soothe your senses. The hotel also features a shared lounge with a TV area, perfect for socializing or catching up on your favorite shows. Additionally, there is a gift and souvenir shop, allowing you to take a piece of your memorable stay at Fairmont Peace Hotel back home with you. Experience the epitome of luxury and entertainment at Fairmont Peace Hotel, where every moment is filled with elegance and excitement.

Stay Active at Fairmont Peace Hotel's Sports Facilities

Fairmont Peace Hotel in Shanghai, China offers an array of top-notch sports facilities to ensure that guests can stay active and maintain their fitness routines during their stay. The hotel boasts an inviting indoor pool, perfect for a refreshing swim or a relaxing dip after a long day of exploring the city. The pool area is beautifully designed, featuring comfortable lounge chairs and a serene atmosphere, making it an ideal spot to unwind and recharge. For those looking to break a sweat, Fairmont Peace Hotel provides a state-of-the-art fitness center equipped with modern exercise machines and equipment. Whether you prefer cardio workouts or strength training, this fitness center has everything you need to achieve your fitness goals. Additionally, guests can take advantage of the complimentary fitness center, allowing them to stay active without any extra cost. Yoga enthusiasts will be delighted to find a dedicated yoga room at Fairmont Peace Hotel. This tranquil space is designed to provide a serene environment for practicing yoga and meditation. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced yogi, you can enjoy a peaceful session and find your inner balance. With its indoor pool, well-equipped fitness center, and serene yoga room, Fairmont Peace Hotel ensures that guests have access to a range of sports facilities to enhance their stay and maintain their wellness routine. Whether you are looking to relax by the pool, break a sweat at the fitness center, or find inner peace through yoga, this hotel has something for everyone.

Unparalleled Convenience at Fairmont Peace Hotel

Fairmont Peace Hotel in Shanghai offers an array of convenience facilities that cater to the needs of every guest. From the moment you step foot into this iconic hotel, you'll be greeted with impeccable service and a range of amenities designed to enhance your stay. For those who crave privacy and comfort, the 24-hour room service ensures that you can indulge in delicious meals or snacks at any time of the day. The laundry service and dry cleaning facilities make it easy for you to keep your clothes fresh and clean, allowing you to pack light and travel hassle-free. Additionally, the daily housekeeping service ensures that your room is always tidy and welcoming. The safety deposit boxes provide a secure place for you to store your valuables, giving you peace of mind throughout your stay. The concierge is always on hand to assist with any requests or recommendations, ensuring that you make the most of your time in Shanghai. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi in all rooms and public areas, allowing you to easily stay in touch with loved ones or catch up on work. For those seeking an elevated experience, the executive lounge access offers a tranquil space to unwind and enjoy exclusive benefits. The express check-in/check-out service and luggage storage facilities further streamline your experience, allowing you to make the most of your time in this vibrant city. Fairmont Peace Hotel truly goes above and beyond to provide unparalleled convenience and comfort for every guest.

Convenient and Hassle-Free Transport Facilities at Fairmont Peace Hotel

At Fairmont Peace Hotel in Shanghai, China, guests can enjoy a wide range of transport facilities that ensure a convenient and hassle-free stay. The hotel offers airport transfer services, making it effortless for guests to travel to and from the airport. Whether you are arriving or departing, the dedicated staff will ensure a smooth and comfortable journey. For those looking to explore the vibrant city of Shanghai, the hotel provides tours and ticket services. Guests can easily book tours to popular attractions or purchase tickets for shows and events, allowing them to make the most of their stay in this dynamic city. Additionally, the hotel offers car hire services, giving guests the freedom to explore at their own pace. Fairmont Peace Hotel also provides a secure and convenient car park onsite. Guests can park their vehicles free of charge, eliminating any worries about finding parking spaces. However, please note that car park charges may be applied for long-term parking. Finally, for quick and hassle-free transportation within the city, the hotel offers a reliable taxi service, ensuring guests can easily reach their desired destinations without any hassle or confusion.

Luxurious Comfort and Modern Amenities at Fairmont Peace Hotel on the Bund

Experience the epitome of elegance and convenience with the thoughtfully designed room facilities at the Fairmont Peace Hotel on the Bund. Each room is equipped with air conditioning to ensure a comfortable stay, complemented by plush linens and towels that add a touch of luxury. Guests can unwind in the separate living room, perfect for relaxation or entertaining, while enjoying in-house movies on the television or catching up on the latest news with the daily newspaper. Enhancing your stay are a range of modern amenities including a mini bar, refrigerator, and complimentary bottled water to keep you refreshed. The room features a coffee/tea maker along with complimentary instant coffee and tea, allowing you to start your day with a warm beverage. For your convenience, there are toiletries, a hair dryer, and blackout curtains to create a restful environment. Whether you’re here for leisure or business, these facilities ensure a seamless and indulgent experience.

Indulge in Culinary Delights at Fairmont Peace Hotel

At Fairmont Peace Hotel in Shanghai, China, guests can embark on a gastronomic journey with an array of dining facilities that cater to every palate. Start your day with a sumptuous breakfast buffet, offering a wide selection of continental delights to energize you for the day ahead. For those who prefer the convenience of dining in the comfort of their rooms, 24-hour room service is available, ensuring that you can satisfy your cravings at any time. If you're in the mood for a casual dining experience, head to the hotel's coffee shop, where you can savor freshly brewed coffee and indulge in delectable pastries. For a more formal dining affair, the hotel's restaurant offers a diverse menu featuring both local and international cuisines. Immerse yourself in the elegant ambiance as you savor expertly crafted dishes prepared by the hotel's talented chefs. To enhance your stay, Fairmont Peace Hotel also offers daily housekeeping, grocery deliveries, and room service, ensuring that you have everything you need at your fingertips. Whether you're a food enthusiast or simply looking for a convenient dining experience, Fairmont Peace Hotel's dining facilities are sure to impress.

Luxurious Room Options at Fairmont Peace Hotel on the Bund

Discover a range of elegant accommodations at the Fairmont Peace Hotel in Shanghai, including the cozy Deluxe Queen and Deluxe King rooms, each offering 45 square meters of comfort with a plush King Bed. For those seeking more space, the Fairmont Queen Queen and Fairmont Twin rooms provide 49 square meters with either a King or two Single Beds, perfect for relaxing after a day exploring the vibrant city. Travelers looking for an elevated experience can opt for the Fairmont Gold rooms, such as the Grand Executive Floor King or the Executive Floor 2 Twin, both offering 49 square meters of refined luxury, or indulge in the spacious One Bedroom Suite or the impressive Signature Riverview Suite, which spans 178 square meters, providing breathtaking views and ultimate comfort.

Discover the Vibrant Charm of The Bund and North Bund in Shanghai

Welcome to the heart of Shanghai, where the iconic Bund and North Bund areas come alive with a vibrant mix of history, culture, and modernity. Situated along the Huangpu River, The Bund is a picturesque waterfront promenade that showcases the city's rich architectural heritage. As you stroll along the Bund, you'll be captivated by the stunning skyline of Shanghai, featuring a blend of colonial-era buildings and futuristic skyscrapers. The Bund is also home to some of the city's most renowned landmarks, including the historic Peace Hotel and the Oriental Pearl Tower, offering breathtaking views from its observation deck. Just across the river, the North Bund offers a different perspective of Shanghai's bustling cityscape. This up-and-coming neighborhood is known for its trendy waterfront parks, stylish cafes, and modern art galleries. Take a leisurely walk along the North Bund Promenade, and you'll be rewarded with panoramic views of the iconic skyline, including the towering Shanghai Tower and the Shanghai World Financial Center. The North Bund is also a haven for food lovers, with its diverse range of international and local dining options, from upscale restaurants to street food stalls serving authentic Shanghainese cuisine. Whether you're a history enthusiast, a culture seeker, or a lover of modern cityscapes, exploring The Bund and North Bund is a must-do experience in Shanghai. Immerse yourself in the vibrant atmosphere, indulge in delectable culinary delights, and witness the seamless blend of old and new that defines this remarkable part of the city.

Traveling to Fairmont Peace Hotel from Shanghai's Airports

Located in the heart of Shanghai's iconic Bund and North Bund area, Fairmont Peace Hotel is easily accessible from the city's airports. Whether you arrive at Shanghai Pudong International Airport (PVG) or Shanghai Hongqiao International Airport (SHA), you have several convenient transportation options to reach the hotel. If you arrive at Shanghai Pudong International Airport, the most convenient way to get to Fairmont Peace Hotel is by taking a taxi or a private car. The journey usually takes around 45 minutes, depending on traffic conditions. Alternatively, you can also take the Shanghai Maglev Train, which is the world's fastest commercial train, reaching speeds of up to 431 km/h. The Maglev Train connects the airport to Longyang Road Station, where you can transfer to Line 2 of the Shanghai Metro and reach East Nanjing Road Station, just a short walk from the hotel. For those arriving at Shanghai Hongqiao International Airport, taxis and private cars are also available for a direct journey to Fairmont Peace Hotel, taking approximately 30 minutes. If you prefer public transportation, you can take Line 10 of the Shanghai Metro from Hongqiao Airport Terminal 2 Station to East Nanjing Road Station, which is within walking distance of the hotel. Whichever airport you arrive at, getting to Fairmont Peace Hotel is a breeze with various transportation options available. Whether you choose the convenience of a taxi or the adventure of riding the Maglev Train, you'll soon find yourself immersed in the elegance and charm of this iconic Shanghai hotel.

Discover the Vibrant Surroundings of Fairmont Peace Hotel

Situated in the heart of Shanghai, Fairmont Peace Hotel offers a prime location surrounded by iconic landmarks and attractions. Just a stone's throw away is The Bund (Wai Tan), a historic waterfront promenade known for its stunning views of the city skyline and the Huangpu River. Take a leisurely stroll along The Bund and soak in the architectural wonders of the Bund International Architecture Exhibition, showcasing a fusion of Western and Chinese architectural styles. For a taste of traditional Chinese culture, head to Yu Garden (Yuyuan) and Old Town (Nanshi). Yu Garden is a meticulously landscaped classical Chinese garden, featuring exquisite pavilions, rockeries, and ponds. Immerse yourself in the vibrant atmosphere of Old Town, where you can explore bustling markets, sample local street food, and marvel at ancient temples like the Shanghai Temple Of the Town God (Chenghung Miao). History buffs will be captivated by the Shanghai Jewish Refugees Museum, which tells the remarkable story of Jewish refugees who found shelter in Shanghai during World War II. Another architectural gem worth visiting is the Heping Fandian, a historic hotel that has witnessed Shanghai's transformation over the years. For a unique shopping experience, make your way to 1933 Old Millfun, a converted slaughterhouse turned creative space that houses trendy boutiques, galleries, and restaurants. Conveniently located near the Intex Exhibition Center, Fairmont Peace Hotel is an ideal choice for business travelers attending events and conferences. And for everyday necessities, Hui Min Supermarket is just a short walk away, ensuring that guests have easy access to any essentials they may need during their stay. With its unbeatable location and proximity to these captivating landmarks and attractions, Fairmont Peace Hotel offers a truly memorable experience in the vibrant city of Shanghai.

Convenient Public Transport Stations Near Fairmont Peace Hotel

Fairmont Peace Hotel in Shanghai, China, is surrounded by a plethora of public transport stations, making it incredibly convenient for guests to explore the city. Just a short walk away from the hotel, you will find several Metro stations, including Jiangpu Park Metro Station, Hongkou Football Stadium Metro Station, Tiantong Road Metro Station, Tilanqiao Metro Station, Youdian Xincun Metro Station, Hailun Road Metro Station, Linping Road Metro Station, North Sichuan Road Metro Station, and International Cruise Terminal Metro Station. These Metro stations provide easy access to all the major attractions and neighborhoods in Shanghai, allowing guests to effortlessly navigate the city's bustling streets and vibrant districts. Additionally, the Yangshuo Bus Station is also conveniently located near Fairmont Peace Hotel. This bus station offers a wide range of bus routes, allowing guests to explore not only Shanghai but also the surrounding areas. Whether you want to visit the famous Bund, explore the trendy Xintiandi district, or venture further out to the picturesque water towns, the Yangshuo Bus Station provides a convenient and affordable transport option. With such a wide array of public transport stations nearby, guests staying at Fairmont Peace Hotel can easily immerse themselves in the rich culture and vibrant atmosphere of Shanghai, ensuring a memorable and hassle-free stay.

A Culinary Journey Awaits

Fairmont Peace Hotel is surrounded by an array of exquisite dining options that will take your taste buds on a culinary journey. Just steps away from the hotel, you'll find the Shanghai Grandmother Restaurant, where you can savor authentic Shanghainese cuisine in a charming and nostalgic setting. For a taste of the exotic, head to Lost Heaven Bar, known for its delectable Yunnanese dishes and vibrant atmosphere. Chenglonghang is another must-visit restaurant nearby, offering mouthwatering Sichuan cuisine that will leave you craving for more. If you're in the mood for some local flavors, make sure to try the Muslim Jincheng Miandian, renowned for its delicious halal noodles. For a taste of contemporary Spanish cuisine, ElWilly is the place to be, serving up innovative dishes that will tantalize your taste buds. The House of Roosevelt offers a fusion of Western and Chinese flavors, with a menu that showcases the best of both worlds. Shanghai Lao Fan Dian is a favorite among locals and tourists alike, serving up traditional Shanghainese dishes with a modern twist. Dahuchun is another hidden gem, known for its mouthwatering dumplings and a variety of regional Chinese dishes. And for a truly unforgettable dining experience, make a reservation at Sir Elly's, located on the top floor of the hotel, where you can indulge in gourmet European cuisine while enjoying breathtaking views of the city skyline. Whether you're a food enthusiast or simply looking to explore the vibrant culinary scene of Shanghai, Fairmont Peace Hotel's surrounding restaurants offer a diverse range of flavors and dining experiences that are sure to satisfy every palate.

Unparalleled Shopping Experience

Located in the heart of Shanghai, Fairmont Peace Hotel offers an unparalleled shopping experience with its proximity to a variety of shopping landmarks. Just a stone's throw away from the hotel, you'll find Bund 18, a historic building that houses a collection of high-end boutiques and luxury brands. If you're looking for a more traditional shopping experience, ShiLiu Pu Cloth Market is the place to go. Here, you can browse through a vast selection of fabrics, clothing, and accessories at bargain prices. For those seeking international brands, Shanghai New World Daimaru is a must-visit. This department store offers a wide range of products, from fashion and beauty to electronics and home goods. If you're in the mood for something unique, head over to the Bird and Flower Market on Zhoujiazui Road. Here, you'll find a vibrant atmosphere filled with colorful flowers, chirping birds, and a wide variety of plants and gardening supplies. Other nearby shopping landmarks include Dashanghai Shop, Kaiphone Plaza, Evian Spa, Zhengda Living Museum Store, and Xingwang International Dress and Finery Market. With such a diverse range of shopping options, Fairmont Peace Hotel is the perfect choice for shopaholics and fashion enthusiasts.

Unparalleled Luxury at an Affordable Price

Indulge in the opulence of Fairmont Peace Hotel without breaking the bank. With an average price of $412 per room, this iconic Shanghai hotel offers a remarkable blend of luxury, history, and world-class service. Compared to the average price of a hotel room in Shanghai, which is $100, Fairmont Peace Hotel stands out as an exceptional value for money. Step into a world of elegance and sophistication as you enter the meticulously designed rooms and suites. Each accommodation is thoughtfully decorated with a harmonious fusion of classic and contemporary elements, offering a serene sanctuary amidst the bustling city. From the breathtaking views of the Bund to the plush furnishings and modern amenities, every aspect of your stay at Fairmont Peace Hotel is designed to exceed your expectations. Whether you're a discerning traveler seeking a memorable stay or a business professional in need of a comfortable retreat, Fairmont Peace Hotel provides an unparalleled experience at a price that won't break the bank. Book your stay today and discover why this hotel is renowned as one of Shanghai's finest.

Exceptional Service and Beautiful Accommodations

Fairmont Peace Hotel in Shanghai is highly recommended for its exceptional service and beautiful accommodations. The staff are friendly, helpful, and speak good English, providing a warm welcome to guests. The rooms are stunning, comfortable, and elegantly designed, with ample space. The hotel's spa is also a highlight, offering a nice and relaxing experience. Additionally, the location is excellent, with well-equipped facilities and an abundance of helpful staff. Guests can also enjoy an excellent buffet breakfast, making their stay even more enjoyable.

activity.title: Shanghai Disney Resort Tickets – Theme Park Admission
activity.description:
Shanghai Disney Resort features the world's largest Disney castle and eight distinct theme parks, offering unforgettable experiences for visitors. Must-see attractions include Animal Crossing and Pirates of the Caribbean, with a range of themed lands to explore. Guests can choose from various ticket options, including parent-child packages and exclusive discounts, for a more tailored visit.

- Special ticket packages are available for the Shanghai Disneyland Hotel and Toy Story Hotel.
- Visitors can find detailed information and tips in the official Shanghai Disney Guide.
- Dining discount coupons and exclusive card combinations are offered with certain ticket purchases.
- Each ticket is valid only for the selected admission date and must be linked via the official app for entry.

activity.title: Shanghai Disney Resort Ticket – Shanghai Disneyland Admission
activity.description:
Experience the magic of Shanghai Disney Resort, Asia’s largest Disney destination blending classic Disney wonder with unique Chinese culture. Indulge in themed treats, including Mickey-shaped dim sum, and enjoy a fairytale adventure filled with vibrant festivities and seasonal celebrations. Dive into the excitement of a magical summer and capture memorable moments with beloved Disney characters.

- Discover special Spring Festival events, from lively drum ceremonies to castle shows with traditional music and dazzling projections.
- Explore Mickey Avenue, where Disney characters greet guests in stylish seasonal outfits and offer Wishing Cards for a festive keepsake.
- Marvel at themed decorations, including winter “ice” statues and prosperous displays celebrating the Year of the Rabbit throughout the park.
- Join in the Shanghai Swing as Mickey and friends dance to lively rhythms, bringing extra joy and energy to your Disney experience.

activity.title: Shanghai Private Transfer – Downtown to/from Pudong Airport (PVG)
activity.description:
Enjoy a seamless and comfortable journey with a 24-hour private transfer between Downtown Shanghai and Shanghai Pudong International Airport (PVG). Skip long taxi lines and crowded public transport with personalized, door-to-door service tailored to your schedule. Professional drivers ensure a smooth ride, letting you relax while your luggage is handled and your trip is stress-free.

- Choose from a fleet of Sedans, Minivans, and Minibuses, all maintained to high safety standards.
- Benefit from a meet and greet service at the airport or your hotel, with drivers holding a sign with your name.
- Receive 60 minutes of free waiting time for airport arrivals and 30 minutes for departures, with clear overtime fees if needed.
- 24/7 customer service support is available via email, WhatsApp, or phone for any assistance during your transfer.
- Each passenger is allowed one piece of luggage (24-inch max); oversized or extra luggage must be arranged in advance.

activity.title: LEGOLAND Shanghai Resort Ticket – Theme Park Admission
activity.description:
Shanghai LEGOLAND Resort is a family-friendly destination in Shanghai, featuring a theme park with eight unique areas and an on-site resort hotel. Visitors can enjoy classic LEGOLAND rides, new themed zones inspired by global cultures, and experiences that highlight traditional Chinese culture and Shanghai elements. With over 75 interactive rides, exciting performances, and entertainment attractions, there’s something for everyone to enjoy.

- The park is designed for families with children aged 2–12, offering a wide range of kid-friendly activities.
- Guests can explore themed lands that blend international LEGO adventures with local Shanghai flair.
- The resort hotel provides convenient accommodation for families looking to extend their stay.
- Live shows and entertainment options are available throughout the day, adding to the fun atmosphere.

activity.title: Shanghai eSIM | Up to 30 Days | VPN Included | Instant Delivery
activity.description:
Stay connected in Shanghai with an instant eSIM QR code delivered to your email within minutes. This prepaid data-only plan supports 4G LTE or 5G speeds, includes VPN access, and can be activated from any location with a stable internet connection. The eSIM works on compatible, network-unlocked devices and starts its validity period upon installation.

- Mobile hotspot is supported, allowing you to share your Shanghai data eSIM connection with other devices.
- The plan is a one-time prepaid package with no auto-renewals or contracts, providing flexibility for travelers.
- Voice calls and SMS are not included; this eSIM is for mobile data usage only.
- No refunds or cancellations are available due to device incompatibility or changes in travel plans, so please confirm your device supports eSIM before purchase.

activity.title: Shanghai Pudong Airport Transfer – Private Chauffeur Service
activity.description:
Enjoy a single-way private transfer between Shanghai Pudong Airport and your downtown hotel with a fully insured, legally compliant vehicle. This service ensures a smooth, convenient, and safe journey, with all charges included and no hidden fees. Relax as a professional driver assists with your luggage, and benefit from 24/7 multilingual customer support for any emergencies.

- The driver will greet you at the airport arrivals hall or hotel lobby, holding a name board for easy identification.
- Free waiting time of 2 hours is provided after your flight lands, giving you ample time for customs and baggage.
- Vehicles are air-conditioned and suitable for all physical fitness levels, with wheelchair accessibility available.
- You can cancel free of charge up to 24 hours before your scheduled transfer.

activity.title: Xuyan Shanghai – Immersive Tang Dynasty Palace Banquet Experience
activity.description:
Step into Xuyan (Shanghai Flagship Store) for an immersive Tang Dynasty banquet that transports you to ancient China through interactive performances, authentic Hanfu costumes, and a 360-degree sensory experience. Savor seasonal menus paired with music, dance, and a spectacular light and shadow show, all set in the heart of Shanghai. This unique palace banquet blends traditional rituals, cuisine, and high-tech artistry, letting you relive the elegance and grandeur of the Tang era.

- Guests can choose from themed menus, including Chang'an Fu and Nezha, each featuring creative dishes and live performances.
- The experience includes both lunch and dinner options, with each meal accompanied by an 80–90 minute show.
- Hanfu rental and makeup services are available for an added historical touch, with clear pricing for each service.
- The venue is located at No. 40 Wenshui Road, Jing'an District, Shanghai, and is easily accessible by car or Metro Line 1.

activity.title: Shanghai Disneyland Experience Pass with Options
activity.description:
Step into a park filled with enchanting lands, thrilling rides, and dazzling shows for all ages. Explore iconic attractions, meet beloved Disney characters, and create lasting memories in this world-famous destination. Perfect for families, couples, and solo travelers, this package takes care of all the logistics, allowing you to focus on the fun and excitement of your Shanghai adventure.
You can spend the day at Shanghai DISNEYLAND—without planning a thing—on a hassle-free adventure with tickets and door-to-door travel included. After you're whisked to the park, you can explore at your leisure to take advantage of the countless family-friendly activities. Wander through the park's themed areas including Fantasyland, Treasure Cove, and Tomorrowland, enjoy live entertainment and world-class dining (at your own expense), and maybe even meet your favorite cartoon characters along the way.

activity.title: Shanghai F1 Race Track Private Round-Trip Transfer – City Area
activity.description:
Enjoy a smooth and exclusive private round-trip transfer between your Shanghai hotel and the Formula One race track in Jiading District. Travel in comfort with a professional driver, flexible departure times, and a choice of vehicles for different group sizes. Avoid the hassle of public transport or long taxi lines, and relax in an air-conditioned car on your way to the Shanghai Circuit.

- Pickup and drop-off are available anywhere in downtown Shanghai for your convenience.
- The service includes a driver who is familiar with pick-up and drop-off details, and basic English is spoken.
- A local English-speaking assistant is available by phone for extra support before or during the transfer.
- The transfer duration is approximately 40 minutes to 1 hour, depending on traffic and hotel location.

activity.title: Shanghai Hotel to International Circuit F1 Private Transfer
activity.description:
Enjoy a private transfer from your hotel in downtown Shanghai to the International Circuit F1 in Jiading District, ensuring a smooth and convenient ride for your group. The service offers various vehicle options to accommodate different group sizes, and your driver will drop you off right at the event location for maximum ease.

- Only your group participates, giving you privacy and flexibility for your Shanghai private transfer.
- Drivers have basic English skills and are supported by professional English-speaking staff for clear communication.
- Choose from car, van, mini bus, or coach depending on your group size for the transfer to International Circuit F1.
- Cancel at least 24 hours before your scheduled pickup for a full refund.

translations.421475:
$100.00 Experience Credit (The Reserve rates only)

The complimentary $100.00 Experience Credit is determined by each hotel and shall be valued at $100.00 (USD). The $100.00 Experience Credit may be in the form of a credit or gift card, provided directly by the hotel. Please contact the hotel directly to inquire about what services are subject to $100.00 Experience Credit. Certain services subject to the $100.00 USD Experience Credit may require advance reservations. Contact the hotel directly for more information and in order to obtain reservations, if required.

Back-to-back stays within 24 hours at the same hotel are considered one stay. Benefits shall be awarded once per stay. If the $100.00 Experience Credit and other benefits are not consumed during the eligible stay, no refunds or compensation shall be provided to you and the remaining balance will be forfeited.

Room Upgrades (The Reserve rates only)

Room Upgrades are based on availability and only certain hotel room categories may be available for upgrade.

Daily Breakfast for Two (The Reserve rates)

Daily Breakfast for Two is included and may be provided directly by the hotel or in the form of a gift card or credit. If breakfast is included as a standard amenity of the hotel, no additional compensation or amenity will be provided to you.

Complimentary Wi-Fi (The Reserve rates and Hotel Collection)

Complimentary Wi-Fi is provided, with the exception of select hotels where Wi-Fi is included as part of a mandatory daily resort fee or is not available. If Wi-Fi is included as a standard amenity of the hotel, no additional compensation or amenity will be provided to you.

comments.reviewComments:
I recently had the pleasure of staying at the Fairmont Peace Hotel with my family, and I must say it exceeded all expectations. From the moment we arrived, we were warmly greeted by the staff, especially Alexander and Rock, who went above and beyond to make our stay comfortable and enjoyable. Their hospitality and attentiveness truly made us feel at home.

One of the standout features of our stay was the exceptional service provided by the Concierge team, Alfred in particular. Every day, they were incredibly helpful, offering valuable recommendations and assistance with our daily plan, helping us in making reservations at other restaurants. Their dedication to ensuring we had a memorable experience was evident in every interaction.

The Fairmont Peace Hotel is a perfect choice for families looking for a luxurious and welcoming stay. We couldn't have asked for a better experience, thanks to the wonderful staff and outstanding service. Highly recommended!

comments.reviewComments: I stayed with breakfast included. The interior of the hotel is very retro, and you can feel that it is well-maintained. Upon arrival, there was a welcome fruit prepared, and the calm atmosphere of the interior created a soothing space. They were able to hold my luggage both before check-in and after check-out, allowing me to fully enjoy my sightseeing. The breakfast was in a buffet style, offering a rich variety from Chinese to Western dishes, and I was very satisfied. All the staff were kind and attentive, and I am truly grateful. This is a hotel I would definitely like to use again.

スタッフの皆さまも親切で丁寧に対応してくださり、心より感謝しております。
またぜひ利用したいホテルです。

The room is luxurious and comfortable, and the overall environment is very elegant, making for a great stay experience. 
I could only book a king-size bed room at the time of reservation, but after expressing my request at check-in, the front desk was very patient in helping to coordinate and ultimately arranged a twin bed room for us. I am very grateful for this thoughtfulness and assistance.

Special thanks to Mr. *** and Miss ***. Upon departure, both of them enthusiastically helped us take our suitcase and carry-on bag with a luggage cart all the way to the North Gate where we waited for a taxi. Their service attitude was excellent, providing us with great peace of mind. (The seniors traveling with us also praised their service highly.)

Overall, both the environment and the service left a deep impression, making it a very pleasant stay experience.
comments.originalComment:
房间豪华舒适，整体环境非常优雅，入住体验很好。
在预订时只能订到大床房，但在办理入住时提出需求后，前台非常耐心地帮助协调，最终为我们安排成双床房，非常感激这份体贴与帮助。

特别感谢***先生 和***小姐。离店时，两位非常热心地从房间帮我们把行李箱和随身包用行李车一路送到北门等出租车的地方，服务态度非常好，让人十分安心。（同行的长辈对他们的服务也赞不绝口。）

整体来说，无论是环境还是服务都令人印象深刻，是一次非常愉快的入住体验。

comments.reviewNegatives: Everything was perfect, we only wish we’d stayed longer. Tip for future guests: book a longer stay; you won’t be disappointed!
comments.reviewPositives: A flawless 5-night family stay (18–23 September) at this living Art Deco museum, Fairmont Peace Hotel exceeded every expectation. Our Fairmont King Room felt like an elegant apartment at 49m², with a super-king bed, even larger than advertised, luxurious finishes, and immaculate twice-daily housekeeping. The hotel’s heritage tours made the history come alive (don’t miss them!), and there were charming nooks to discover everywhere. Location is unbeatable, directly opposite the Bund and moments from the main shopping strip yet the interiors are serenely quiet. We loved the Jazz Bar, and the gym and pool were top-notch, but it was the service that truly made our stay: every staff member was warm and proactive, and a special thank-you to Alexander, who checked in on us throughout our stay and even arranged a private tour. The team graciously accommodated a late checkout for our evening flight and made it effortless when we decided to add an extra night.
